items.headline: $INJ Surges 27%, Outpacing NEAR and Sei
items.summary: $INJ jumped 27% in 24 hours, beating $NEAR, $SEI and Cosmos Hub, as a proposed 21Shares fund would hold the token directly with discretionary staking.

items.headline: Jupiter's YOLO Hits $1B Volume in Under 24 Hours
items.summary: Jupiter's unaudited YOLO beta, offering up to 1,000x leverage, logged $1B in volume in its first day. Winners are paid from a house pool funded by trader losses.

items.headline: $TIA Climbs 59% in Four Weeks Despite Slipping Blob Demand
items.summary: Celestia's $TIA is up 59% in a month even as daily blob data fell during the rally, with its new Fibre throughput benchmark still separate from mainnet usage.

items.headline: $FIL to Shift Block Rewards Toward Paid Storage
items.summary: Under FIP-0118, Filecoin will cut the consensus share of each $FIL block reward from 95% toward a 50% floor over nine quarters, burning any unearned service share.

items.headline: Unagi Liquidation Puts $UNA Token Contracts Up for Sale
items.summary: Unagi is selling Persona's IP, a 957-NFT treasury and the $UNA token contracts in liquidation, with offers due November 2.
